plans.idea: Classic left-to-right banner read: brand lockup, then the bottle, then a wide '30% OFF' text block, ending on the yellow CTA with the legal set as a fine line beneath it.
Product-led: the bottle anchors the left edge right beside the widest possible headline block, and the right side holds a CTA-over-brand group with the logo and legal side by side under the button.
Offer-first: a brand column (logo over legal) leads into the big '30% OFF' text, then the bottle sits as a visual pause before the CTA closes the row on the right edge.
